name: Auxiliary-board incoming-supply alarm
summary: Reports loss of the monitored incoming supply to the auxiliary AC board.
description: Reports loss of the monitored incoming supply to the auxiliary AC board. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Incoming voltage condition” at the input and “Auxiliary supply-loss indication” at the output. Individual branches can fail while the incoming remains healthy.
